bio.text: LaVon Bracy Davis is a Democratic member of the Florida Senate for District 15, elected on September 2, 2025.
According to the Senate's biographical page, Bracy Davis served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2022 to September 1, 2025.
Bracy Davis is an attorney with a B.F.A. from Howard University (2001) and a J.D. from Florida A&M University College of Law (2005), and was born in Rochester, New York.
